name: Strategy & Planning Rituals
promise: Clarify purpose, vision, values and goals, and drive alignment.
whoFor: Founders and leadership teams who have a plan on paper but not in practice.
delivered: Goals framework (objectives, measurable outcomes, monthly initiatives)
engagementLength: 4-8 weeks, typically starting with a Full Circle Exploration of stakeholders

name: Innovation Rituals
promise: Let teams think new without the fear of failure.
whoFor: Teams that have stopped experimenting because failure feels risky.
delivered: Psychological-safety practices embedded into existing routines
engagementLength: Project-based, typically 4-6 weeks per ritual design cycle

name: Execution & Agility Rituals
whoFor: Organisations where execution fails not from lack of ideas but lack of rhythm.
delivered: Decision-making and workflow mapping across departments
Design of stand-up, sync, and review cadences

name: Customer Centricity Rituals
promise: Bring the voice of the customer into day-to-day decisions.
whoFor: Teams whose customer feedback lives in a dashboard nobody acts on.
delivered: Integration of customer signals into recurring reviews

name: People & Culture Rituals
whoFor: Organisations investing in growth who need their people practices to keep pace.
delivered: Onboarding journeys rooted in purpose and clarity

name: Collaboration & Trust Rituals
promise: Break silos and build cross-functional trust.
whoFor: Companies where teams work in parallel but rarely in sync.
delivered: Feedback loops that surface across teams, not just up the chain

name: Brand Diagnosis & Discovery
promise: Understand where your brand actually stands, inside the business and against competitors.
whoFor: Leadership teams making a strategic decision that hinges on brand clarity.

name: Brand Valuation
promise: An independent, defensible valuation of what your brand is worth.
whoFor: Companies raising capital, going through M&A, or reporting brand impact to a board.

name: Brand Licensing Structuring
promise: Turn a personal or promoter-owned brand into a properly licensed, monetisable asset.
whoFor: Founders or trusts where the brand is personally owned but used by the business.

name: Leadership & Alignment Workshops
promise: Get a leadership team aligned on what matters most, fast.
whoFor: Leadership teams that need to converge on priorities, not just discuss them.
delivered: Prioritised set of initiatives with clear ownership
